svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.square-rhombus-both-diagonals-comparison", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Explore four equal rods/frames and cords joining opposite corners before the diagrams. Identify both diagonals and their central crossing. The upper square is a special rhombus;the lower non-square rhombus is a contrasting example,not a mutually exclusive shape class. In the authored geometry,square diagonals are equal;non-square diagonals are unequal and perpendicular. Each pair bisects at the centre. Frame sizes differ,so this is not a common-perimeter or area comparison. Teach rotation invariance;no length ticks,labels or angle code. Native Index dots leave larger5.5mm endpoint neighbourhood intervals to avoid crowded branch points;their tactile continuity is untested.", "geometry_exception": "Index native graphic dots retain logical centreline/point locations;5.5mm joint guards only in quadrilateral sampling. Point lattice footprint is3mm Swell/VP and1.2mm Index. Not exact sourceworksheet.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Explicit1.2mm graphic dots at common logicalpoints or guarded centreline samples;notBraille. Endpoint interval5.5mm inboth-diagonal comparison avoidsclose branchdots;physical continuitypending.
